motion.purpose: House easing for every transition and the door leaf opening.

motion.name: ease-fold
motion.purpose: Accelerating fold of the shut door face toward its hinge.

motion.name: door-word-fade
motion.purpose: Painted word leaves the shut face before it folds.

motion.name: door-fold
motion.purpose: Shut face folds to its hinge.

motion.name: door-leaf-open
motion.purpose: Leaf swings open toward the viewer after the fold.

motion.name: hero-door-delay
motion.purpose: The one on-load swing, once the headline has set.

motion.name: colonnade-scrub
motion.value: pinned, scrub 0.5, length 1.8 x viewport height, min viewport 900 x 760
motion.purpose: One scroll timeline drives all three ways-in doors via --p (0 shut, 1 open); text rises from opacity 0.7 / 14px at +0.35 per door.

motion.name: door-reveal-small
motion.purpose: Below the colonnade size, each door opens once as it enters.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Underline thickness, field borders, arrow nudge (3px).

motion.name: page-transition
motion.purpose: Cross-document view transition; off under reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: no .motion class; transitions 0.01ms; view transitions off
motion.purpose: Every door drawn in its final state; nothing animates.

narrative.overview:
The whole system is one picture repeated: a warm room seen from outside, with its door swinging open. Warm Cream is the daylight ground, Deep Ink is the masonry, and Sunrise is the light that spills out once a door opens. The arch from the logo is the only graphic device, drawn at the mark's own proportions (width 30 : springline 21.5 : radius 15) with a 5-unit ink jamb and a ground rule underfoot. It appears as the hero colonnade, as the three ways in, as the frame around every portrait, and as the closed door on empty and 404 states.

The palette, the two typefaces and the arch are binding brand commitments from the hkcarre/humanfirstai brand book. They are recorded here as fixed inputs, not as choices this site is free to revisit. What this file adds is how the build composes them.

Density is low and type is large. Headlines are heavy Jakarta set tight; anything read for more than a sentence is Atkinson Hyperlegible at 17px or larger. Surfaces are flat colour fields separated by 2px ink rules, never floated on shadows. Motion is rare and literal: a door opens, and that is the whole vocabulary. Every page renders complete, with every door drawn in its finished state, before any script runs.
keyCharacteristics: Flat cream ground, ink structure, Sunrise as light and as the one action colour.
One graphic device: the Open Threshold arch, always at the mark's geometry.
Heavy, tight, sentence-case Jakarta headlines over a calm Atkinson reading face.
Ruled lists (2px ink) instead of cards; one full ink field per page at most, plus the ink footer.
Motion means a door opening. Nothing else animates beyond small hover feedback.
Static-first: no content or picture depends on JavaScript or on motion being allowed.

rules.name: The Light Rule
rules.body: Sunrise is light, not decoration. It fills an open doorway, a knob, the primary button or a chosen option, and nothing else. If an element is not an opening or an action, it is not Sunrise.

rules.name: The Swap Rule
rules.body: On ink, roles swap through `data-theme="ink"`: surface becomes Deep Ink, text Warm Cream, accent text Sunrise, links Sky, focus ring Sunrise. Components read the role tokens (`--hf-surface`, `--hf-text`, `--hf-text-accent`) so the same markup works on both grounds.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Jakarta for anything you glance at (headings, labels, buttons, navigation); Atkinson for anything you read for more than a sentence. Bold inside prose switches to Jakarta 700.

rules.name: The Floor Rule
rules.body: Nothing below 14px; body 17px or larger; headings in sentence case, never all caps; text is never justified. Headings use `text-wrap: balance`, paragraphs `pretty`.

rules.name: The Tight Punctuation Rule
rules.body: At poster and display sizes, trailing `, . ; : ?` are pulled 0.06em back toward the word so Jakarta's loose punctuation does not open a gap.

rules.name: The Flat Ground Rule
rules.body: Content never floats. Separation is a 2px Deep Ink rule, a change to the ink field, or space. A shadow is permitted only on something that actually overlays the page.

rules.name: The One Gesture Rule
rules.body: The only animation in the world is a door opening: once on load, and once per door in the colonnade as you scroll. Everything else is hover feedback under 200ms and a 240ms cross-page fade during which the logo stays put.

rules.name: The Finished Picture Rule
rules.body: The HTML always holds the final picture. Motion may close a door first in order to open it; it may never be the reason something is visible.

dos: **Do** draw every arch from the Door component or the portrait clip, at the 30 : 21.5 : 15 geometry with an ink ground rule.
**Do** keep Sunrise for opened doorways, knobs, the primary button and a chosen option, with Deep Ink on top.
**Do** separate content with 2px Deep Ink rules and fluid section space (72 to 136px), not with boxes.
**Do** set headings in Jakarta 700 to 800 sentence case with tight negative tracking, and running text in Atkinson at 17px or more.
**Do** put `data-theme="ink"` on any container that sits on Deep Ink and let the role tokens swap.
**Do** render every door in its finished state in HTML and gate motion behind the `motion` class, which is only set when reduced motion is not requested.
**Do** keep every target at least 44px and keep the 3px focus ring visible on every interactive element.
donts: **Don't** introduce a second graphic device: no blobs, swooshes, mesh gradients, dot grids, robots, circuits, glowing brains, black glass, cyan or glow.
**Don't** set Sunrise or Sky as text on cream; they are fills.
**Don't** put shadows on content, or build card grids; a shadow belongs only to something that overlays the page.
**Don't** animate anything other than a door opening, or give each element its own independent reveal.
**Don't** set text below 14px, set headings in all caps, or justify text.
**Don't** place Ink Muted, Sunrise Deep or Sky Deep text on anything darker than Warm Cream; they sit at the 4.5:1 line there.
**Don't** use stock photographs; portraits are real team members or an initial in the arch.
